From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Ms. LOFGREN:
H.R. 8014.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
is primarily authorized by Congress's Article I power to
regulate interstate commerce, as it governs how commercial
entities collect and use personal data. It is designed to
establish comprehensive privacy rights, data minimization
requirements, and a dedicated Digital Privacy
